desc.en: AI-First Transactional & Marketing Email Service. Free tier: 5,000 emails/mo, 200 emails/day, 10,000 contacts, 5 domains. No credit card required. SDKs, MCP and REST API available.
desc.zh: AI 优先的事务性与营销邮件服务。免费套餐：每月 5,000 封邮件、每天 200 封、10,000 个联系人、5 个域名。无需信用卡。提供 SDK、MCP 和 REST API。

desc.en: Free, temporary email for testing.
desc.zh: 免费的临时邮箱，用于测试。

desc.en: Transactional email service, free for 1000 emails per month, with unlimited domains, team members, webhooks and message routes in the free plan.
desc.zh: 事务性邮件服务，每月免费 1000 封邮件，免费套餐中域名、团队成员、webhook 和邮件路由数量不限。

desc.en: Open-source anonymous email forwarding, create unlimited email aliases for free
desc.zh: 开源的匿名邮件转发，免费创建不限数量的邮件别名

desc.en: Open source, anonymous email alias/forwarding solution with PGP encryption, reply capability, 10 random & 1 custom alias on the free plan with developer API & CLI.
desc.zh: 开源、匿名的邮件别名/转发方案，支持 PGP 加密和回复功能；免费套餐含 10 个随机别名和 1 个自定义别名，提供开发者 API 和 CLI。

desc.en: 10 API requests per hour for email verification, IP, and phone number validation in the free tier. No Credit Cards are required.
desc.zh: 免费套餐每小时可进行 10 次 API 请求，用于邮件验证、IP 和电话号码校验。无需信用卡。

desc.en: transactional and broadcast email API. 3,000 emails/month free, then as low as 8¢ per 1k
desc.zh: 事务性和群发邮件 API。每月免费 3,000 封邮件，之后低至每 1,000 封 8¢

desc.en: Email built for AI agents, entirely free. Programmatic inbox creation, custom domains, and full send/receive over the open JMAP standard (RFC 8620/8621); hosted MCP server available. A real mailbox service, not disposable/temporary email.
desc.zh: 为 AI 代理打造的邮件服务，完全免费。支持以编程方式创建收件箱、自定义域名，并基于开放的 JMAP 标准（RFC 8620/8621）完整收发邮件；提供托管 MCP 服务器。这是真实邮箱服务，而非一次性/临时邮箱。

desc.en: 9,000 emails/month, 300 emails/day free
desc.zh: 每月 9,000 封邮件、每天 300 封免费

desc.en: Free 10 Bump email addresses, one custom domain
desc.zh: 免费 10 个 Bump 邮箱地址，一个自定义域名

desc.en: Free 5 Burner Email Addresses, 1 Mailbox, 7-day Mailbox History
desc.zh: 免费 5 个 Burner 邮箱地址、1 个邮箱、7 天邮箱历史记录

desc.en: Newsletter service. Up to 100 subscribers free
desc.zh: 新闻通讯服务。最多 100 名订阅者免费

desc.en: DMARC monitoring platform with DNS drift alerts, IP threat intel and unlimited users. First domain is free - no credit card required.
desc.zh: DMARC 监控平台，提供 DNS 漂移告警、IP 威胁情报，用户数量不限。第一个域名免费——无需信用卡。

desc.en: Turn incoming emails into webhooks to trigger your API from emails. The service is completely free.
desc.zh: 将收到的邮件转换为 webhook，从而通过邮件触发你的 API。该服务完全免费。

desc.en: Contact form in a link (bitly for contact forms)
desc.zh: 一个链接里的联系表单（联系表单版的 bitly）

desc.en: Easy to use testing mail server for developers
desc.zh: 面向开发者的易用测试邮件服务器

desc.en: Test if the email's DNS/SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings are correct, free service by roundsphere.com
desc.zh: 测试邮件的 DNS/SPF/DKIM/DMARC 设置是否正确，roundsphere.com 提供的免费服务

desc.en: Up to 2 Email addresses under your domain for free with 100MB of storage space. IMAP, POP3, SMTP, SPF/DKIM support.
desc.zh: 你的域名下最多免费提供 2 个邮箱地址，含 100MB 存储空间。支持 IMAP、POP3、SMTP、SPF/DKIM。

desc.en: Block disposable emails, catch typos, and validate MX records via a simple API. 100 free requests/month.
desc.zh: 通过简单的 API 屏蔽一次性邮箱、捕获拼写错误并验证 MX 记录。每月 100 次免费请求。

desc.en: This is not an entire email server; this is just an email client that you can use to send emails right from the client without exposing your credentials, the free tier has 200 monthly requests, 2 email templates, Requests up to 50Kb, Limited contacts history.
desc.zh: 这不是完整的邮件服务器，而只是一个邮件客户端，可让你直接从客户端发送邮件而不暴露凭据；免费套餐含每月 200 次请求、2 个邮件模板、请求大小上限 50Kb、有限的联系人历史记录。

desc.en: Send up to 9,000 Emails for free every month, up to 300 emails daily.
desc.zh: 每月免费发送最多 9,000 封邮件，每天最多 300 封。

desc.en: Free email infrastructure grader that checks SPF, DKIM, DMARC and mail server configuration. Scores any domain out of 100. No signup required.
desc.zh: 免费的邮件基础设施评分工具，检查 SPF、DKIM、DMARC 和邮件服务器配置。为任意域名打出满分 100 的分数。无需注册。

desc.en: Up to 2,500 subscribers and 10,000 emails per month free
desc.zh: 最多 2,500 名订阅者和每月 10,000 封邮件免费

desc.en: 100 free email verifications per month
desc.zh: 每月 100 次免费邮件验证

desc.en: free 12,000 emails/month, Email API and SMTP, SPF/DKIM/DMARC support, No Credit Cards are required.
desc.zh: 每月免费 12,000 封邮件，提供邮件 API 和 SMTP，支持 SPF/DKIM/DMARC，无需信用卡。

desc.en: Ethereal is a fake SMTP service, mainly aimed at Nodemailer and EmailEngine users (but not limited to). It's an entirely free anti-transactional email service where messages never get delivered.
desc.zh: Ethereal 是一个模拟 SMTP 服务，主要面向 Nodemailer 和 EmailEngine 用户（但不限于此）。这是一项完全免费的反事务性邮件服务，消息永远不会真正投递。

desc.en: Free email forwarding for custom domains. Create and forward an unlimited amount of email addresses with your domain name (**note**: You must pay if you use .casa, .cf, .click, .email, .fit, .ga, .gdn, .gq, .lat, .loan, .london, .men, .ml, .pl, .rest, .ru, .tk, .top, .work TLDs due to spam)
desc.zh: 面向自定义域名的免费邮件转发。可使用你的域名创建并转发不限数量的邮箱地址（**注意**：若使用 .casa、.cf、.click、.email、.fit、.ga、.gdn、.gq、.lat、.loan、.london、.men、.ml、.pl、.rest、.ru、.tk、.top、.work 等 TLD，由于垃圾邮件问题必须付费）

desc.en: Sandbox Email Server for testing email functionality across build/qa and ci/cd. Free accounts get 15 emails a day forever.
desc.zh: 用于在 build/qa 和 ci/cd 环节测试邮件功能的沙箱邮件服务器。免费账户永久每天 15 封邮件。

desc.en: Free email forwarding.
desc.zh: 免费邮件转发。

desc.en: Create up to 3 temporary emails a day, then delete them when you're done from within a handy Chrome extension. Perfect for testing signup flows.
desc.zh: 每天创建最多 3 个临时邮箱，用完后可通过便捷的 Chrome 扩展删除。非常适合测试注册流程。

desc.en: Free temporary/disposable email inbox, with up to 3-day email auto-deletes. Open source and can be self-hosted.
desc.zh: 免费的临时/一次性邮箱，邮件最长 3 天后自动删除。开源并可自托管。

desc.en: Detect and block disposable email addresses. Free plan of 250 lookups a month and no card required.
desc.zh: 检测并屏蔽一次性邮箱地址。免费套餐每月 250 次查询，无需银行卡。

desc.en: Email forwarding for custom domains with ARC/DKIM signing. Free plan includes 1 domain, 1 mailbox, 300 emails/month, and up to 1MB message size. Email receiving webhook also available. Special plans for open-source projects.
desc.zh: 面向自定义域名的邮件转发，带 ARC/DKIM 签名。免费套餐包含 1 个域名、1 个邮箱、每月 300 封邮件、消息大小上限 1MB。还提供邮件接收 webhook。为开源项目提供专属套餐。

desc.en: Test if the email's DNS/SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings are correct, 20 free/month.
desc.zh: 测试邮件的 DNS/SPF/DKIM/DMARC 设置是否正确，每月 20 次免费。

desc.en: SMTP relay and email API for developers. 5,000 emails per month, unlimited domains, free email verification, blacklist monitoring, mail tester and more.
desc.zh: 面向开发者的 SMTP 中继和邮件 API。每月 5,000 封邮件，域名不限，含免费邮件验证、黑名单监控、邮件测试等。

desc.en: Catches mail and serves it through a web interface.
desc.zh: 拦截邮件并通过 Web 界面展示。

desc.en: Email API with REST API and SMTP integrations, free for upto 3,000 emails/month.
desc.zh: 提供 REST API 和 SMTP 集成的邮件 API，每月免费最多 3,000 封邮件。

desc.en: Prevent users to sign up with temporary email addresses, 120 requests/hour (~86,400 per month)
desc.zh: 防止用户使用临时邮箱地址注册，120 次请求/小时（约每月 86,400 次）

desc.en: Up to 100 subscribers and unlimited emails as well as automations for free.
desc.zh: 免费支持最多 100 名订阅者，邮件数量和自动化流程不限。

desc.en: 1,000 subscribers/month, 12,000 emails/month free
desc.zh: 每月 1,000 名订阅者、12,000 封邮件免费

desc.en: Email API, SMTP, 500 emails/month free for transactional emails, 100 API requests/day
desc.zh: 邮件 API、SMTP，事务性邮件每月免费 500 封，每天 100 次 API 请求

desc.en: Free, public email system where you can use any inbox you want
desc.zh: 免费、公共的邮件系统，你可以使用任意想要的收件箱

desc.en: 6,000 emails/month free (200 emails daily sending limit)
desc.zh: 每月 6,000 封邮件免费（每天发送上限 200 封）

desc.en: Free API for temporary email testing, free public email hosting, outbound capture, email-to-slack/websocket/webhook (1,500 monthly API limit)
desc.zh: 用于临时邮件测试的免费 API，免费公共邮件托管、外发捕获、邮件转发至 slack/websocket/webhook（每月 API 上限 1,500 次）

desc.en: Email API and SMTP with 4,000 emails/month free, limited to 150 emails/day. Email Marketing includes 500 contacts and 1,500 emails/month. Email Sandbox includes 50 test emails/month, one sandbox, and up to 10 stored emails.
desc.zh: 邮件 API 和 SMTP，每月免费 4,000 封邮件，每天限 150 封。邮件营销含 500 个联系人、每月 1,500 封邮件。邮件沙箱含每月 50 封测试邮件、1 个沙箱、最多存储 10 封邮件。

desc.en: Free 10 Email IDs, 1 Domain, 1 Mailbox. Single Mailbox for All Email IDs.
desc.zh: 免费 10 个邮箱 ID、1 个域名、1 个邮箱。所有邮箱 ID 共用单个邮箱。

desc.en: 10,000 emails/month,No Credit Cards are required.
desc.zh: 每月 10,000 封邮件，无需信用卡。

desc.en: Free bulk email validator, 100 validations per day, no signup required.
desc.zh: 免费批量邮件验证器，每天 100 次验证，无需注册。

desc.en: Free email parser (Forward email, extract the data, send it to your server)
desc.zh: 免费邮件解析器（转发邮件、提取数据、发送到你的服务器）

desc.en: 3K emails/month for free
desc.zh: 每月免费 3K 封邮件

desc.en: 100 emails/month free, unlimited DMARC weekly digests.
desc.zh: 每月 100 封邮件免费，DMARC 每周摘要不限数量。

desc.en: Free secure email account service provider with built-in end-to-end encryption. Free 1GB storage.
desc.zh: 免费的安全邮箱账户服务提供商，内置端到端加密。免费 1GB 存储。

desc.en: Transactional email API and SMTP for developers. Free plan: 3,000 emails/month, 200 emails/day, one custom domain and one agent inbox.
desc.zh: 面向开发者的事务性邮件 API 和 SMTP。免费套餐：每月 3,000 封邮件、每天 200 封、一个自定义域名和一个代理收件箱。

desc.en: Transactional emails API for developers. 3,000 emails/month, 100 emails/day free, one custom domain.
desc.zh: 面向开发者的事务性邮件 API。每月 3,000 封、每天 100 封免费，含一个自定义域名。

desc.en: Free email deliverability test with no signup. Generates a unique inbox address, then analyzes SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Rspamd spam score, 23+ RBL blacklists, reverse DNS, and content quality. Unlimited tests, results in seconds, shareable report pages.
desc.zh: 免费的邮件送达率测试，无需注册。生成一个唯一的收件箱地址，然后分析 SPF、DKIM、DMARC、Rspamd 垃圾邮件评分、23+ 个 RBL 黑名单、反向 DNS 和内容质量。测试次数不限，数秒出结果，报告页面可分享。

desc.en: Up to 15,000 emails/month, up to 2,500 subscribers
desc.zh: 每月最多 15,000 封邮件，最多 2,500 名订阅者

desc.en: 500 subscribers/month, 15,000 emails/month free
desc.zh: 每月 500 名订阅者、15,000 封邮件免费

desc.en: Email framework as a service, that adds templates, automations, history, etc to your own SMTP server (E.g. AWS, Maileroo, Gmail). Free up to 100 emails/day, no time limit.
desc.zh: 邮件框架即服务，为你自己的 SMTP 服务器（如 AWS、Maileroo、Gmail）增加模板、自动化、历史记录等。免费支持每天最多 100 封邮件，无时间限制。

desc.en: Open source, self-hostable email alias/forwarding solution. Free 10 Aliases, unlimited bandwidth, unlimited reply/send. Free for educational staff (student, researcher, etc.).
desc.zh: 开源、可自托管的邮件别名/转发方案。免费 10 个别名，带宽不限，回复/发送不限。教育工作者（学生、研究人员等）免费。

desc.en: SMTPfast is a simple email API for developers with a free tier that includes 3,000 emails/month, 1 domain, and 1,000 contacts, with no credit card required.
desc.zh: SMTPfast 是面向开发者的简单邮件 API，免费套餐包含每月 3,000 封邮件、1 个域名和 1,000 个联系人，无需信用卡。

desc.en: Unlimited free newsletter service. Start paying when you charge for it.
desc.zh: 不限数量的免费新闻通讯服务。当你开始收费时才需付费。

desc.en: A user-friendly DMARC monitoring platform. The free plan covers one domain with up to 1,000 emails per month.
desc.zh: 用户友好的 DMARC 监控平台。免费套餐覆盖一个域名，每月最多 1,000 封邮件。

desc.en: European transactional emails API for developers. 100 emails/day free.
desc.zh: 面向开发者的欧洲事务性邮件 API。每天免费 100 封。

desc.en: Free disposable temporary email service with multiple emails at once and forwarding
desc.zh: 免费的一次性临时邮箱服务，可同时使用多个邮箱并支持转发

desc.en: Temporary / Disposable Mail Gen Utilizing a range variety of domain. Email Address refreshes every time the page is reloaded. It is entirely free and does not include any pricing for their services.
desc.zh: 临时/一次性邮箱生成工具，使用多种域名。每次页面重新加载时邮箱地址都会刷新。完全免费，其服务不包含任何付费项目。

desc.en: Verify up to 200 emails a month for free and see if an email is temporary or not.
desc.zh: 每月免费验证最多 200 封邮件，查看邮箱是否为临时邮箱。

desc.en: Free disposable email addresses with forwarding and automatic address expiration
desc.zh: 免费的一次性邮箱地址，支持转发和地址自动到期

desc.en: Free secure email account service provider with built-in end-to-end encryption, no ads, no tracking. Free 1GB storage, one calendar (Tuta also have an [paid plan](https://tuta.com/pricing).). Tuta is also partially [open source](https://github.com/tutao/tutanota), so you can self-host.
desc.zh: 免费的安全邮箱账户服务提供商，内置端到端加密，无广告、无跟踪。免费 1GB 存储、一个日历（Tuta 也提供[付费套餐](https://tuta.com/pricing)）。Tuta 也有部分[开源](https://github.com/tutao/tutanota)，因此你可以自托管。

desc.en: Real-time email verification API with mailbox confirmation and disposable email address detector; 25 free email verifications/day.
desc.zh: 实时邮件验证 API，带收件箱确认和一次性邮箱检测器；每天免费 25 次邮件验证。

desc.en: Bulk and API email verification service. 100 free verifications/month
desc.zh: 批量和 API 邮件验证服务。每月 100 次免费验证

desc.en: Waitlist management software for product launches. Create branded waitlist pages, collect and verify email subscribers, manage signups with tags and analytics. Free plan includes 100 subscribers/month, 1 waitlist, and API access.
desc.zh: 面向产品发布的等候名单管理软件。创建品牌化等候名单页面、收集并验证邮件订阅者、通过标签和分析管理注册。免费套餐包含每月 100 名订阅者、1 个等候名单和 API 访问权限。

desc.en: email automation workflows, 5k tracked events and unlimited contacts free.
desc.zh: 邮件自动化工作流，免费支持 5k 个已跟踪事件，联系人不限。

desc.en: Free SMTP relay on the msgwing.com domain, up to 200 emails/day, no paid tier. Sends from a shared @msgwing.com address only (no custom domain). Ready-to-run code examples in 15 languages plus Windows Server/Linux/network printer setup guides.
desc.zh: 基于 msgwing.com 域名的免费 SMTP 中继，每天最多 200 封邮件，无付费套餐。仅能从共享的 @msgwing.com 地址发送（不支持自定义域名）。提供 15 种语言的可直接运行代码示例，以及 Windows Server/Linux/网络打印机设置指南。
